source.title: Adjuvant Pembrolizumab after Nephrectomy in Renal-Cell Carcinoma

coverage_decision: Full primary article coverage; full supplementary appendix visual scan; protocol text mapped in full with both supplied versions identified and final amendment 564-04 treated as governing planned-method context.

figures.content: DFS Kaplan-Meier curve and 15 displayed subgroup estimates

tables.content: Any-cause adverse events with incidence at least 10%

figures.content: Between-arm risk differences for selected adverse events
FKSI-DRS and EORTC QLQ-C30 changes over time
Log-log curves for DFS and OS

non_result_material.investigator_roster: supplement pp. 2-12, inspected but not reproduced
non_result_material.data_monitoring_committee: supplement p. 13, represented in oversight context

protocol.omitted_with_reason: Historical duplicate operational schedules, laboratory forms, specimen instructions, administrative boilerplate, and future-biomedical-research appendices were mapped but not reproduced because they do not change interpretation of the reported trial results.

source_integrity_findings.finding: Final amendment 564-04 change summary says the phrase "from a subset" was removed so all imaging scans would receive BICR, but final protocol section 9.2.1 still says a blinded audit for a subset. Section 10.2 states BICR will be performed on imaging scans without the subset qualifier.
source_integrity_findings.impact: Does not change the reported primary endpoint, which was investigator-assessed DFS. BICR was not the primary result in this article.

source_integrity_findings.finding: Final protocol expected IA1 near 265 DFS events and shows an expected-event efficacy boundary of one-sided p=0.0122. The article analyzed 260 qualifying DFS events and reports an actual one-sided boundary of 0.0114.
source_integrity_findings.impact: The protocol states boundaries are adjusted for the actual event count. The packet does not explicitly narrate why 260 qualifying events remained in the analysis, so the difference is preserved rather than silently harmonized.

source_integrity_findings.finding: Table S2 identifies two bone-metastasis cases in the pembrolizumab arm and one brain-metastasis case in the placebo arm as protocol violations within M1 NED. Table S1 also notes five lower-stage M0 intermediate-to-high risk protocol violations.
source_integrity_findings.impact: Small protocol-deviation counts are disclosed and do not alter the trial identity or main intention-to-treat analysis.

omissions_and_gaps: The author disclosure forms and the full data-sharing statement are referenced by the article but are not present in the packet.
No external current-practice or regulatory verification was performed. The artifact appraises the supplied 2021 source packet.
